name: cascade_delete
description: In `app.delete('/api/customers/:c_custkey')`, child `orders` records are explicitly deleted via `Order.destroy({ where: { o_custkey } })` before the parent `customer` is deleted. The `app.get('/api/orders/monthly-trend')` endpoint depends on all `orders` rows to compute monthly aggregates; deleting a customer permanently removes their orders, causing this read endpoint to return incomplete historical data.
